\chapter{Mo's Algorithm}
\label{ch:mo}

\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, colback=white, colframe=secondaryblue, boxrule=1pt, arc=2mm]
\textbf{\large\textcolor{primaryblue}{Reorder offline range queries so that moving from one window to the next is cheap: $\bigO{(n+q)\sqrt{n}}$ pointer moves.}}
\end{tcolorbox}
